decided: The sensor watching the change's planned files fires only on a changed file the plan did not list that is also outside a configured set of exempt paths, by default tests and docs; the exempt set is fixed together with the plan before the run.
alternatives: fire only when a changed file lies outside every directory the plan names
fire on any changed file the plan did not list, and let the trial judge whether that stops too often
why: Tests and docs added beside the work are routine, so firing on them would make most of these stops unwarranted; a coarser directory check would let a source file beside a planned one pass unseen.

defines.definition: A check orbit runs over the code, the change and its history that reports whether a run has gone off course; when it fires, orbit writes a stop record of the tripwire kind.
